pr.title: fix(mcp): restore GPT Researcher container entrypoint
pr.body:
## Summary
- Adds a /app/server.py compatibility wrapper inside the GPT Researcher MCP image so stale client commands work.
- Updates the pinned gpt-researcher package from 0.14.8 to 0.15.1.
- Adds a narrow Dockerfile regression test and proof note.

## Test Plan
- python -m json.tool task-packets/generated/TP-DMX-GPTR-MCP-CONTAINER-UPDATE-001.json >/dev/null
- python -m jsonschema -i task-packets/generated/TP-DMX-GPTR-MCP-CONTAINER-UPDATE-001.json docs/03-reference/spec/dopetask/dopetask-canonical-spec.json
- python -m pytest -q tests/docker/test_gptr_mcp_dockerfile.py
- docker compose -f compose.yml config --quiet
- docker compose -f compose.yml build gptr-mcp
- docker compose -f compose.yml up -d gptr-mcp
- docker exec dopemux-mcp-gptr-mcp python -m py_compile /app/server.py /app/gptr-mcp/server.py
- docker inspect --format '{{json .State.Health.Status}}' dopemux-mcp-gptr-mcp
- git diff --check

## Security Note
- Do not include provider keys or raw environment values in proof.

@codex review
@gemini
@copilot

steps.task: Preflight repo identity, worktree isolation, dirty state, package versions, and container failure surface.
validation: Worktree is isolated from the dirty primary checkout.
Running container has gpt-researcher 0.14.8 before this packet.
PyPI reports gpt-researcher 0.15.1 as current at implementation time.
Running container lacks /app/server.py while MCP client config calls that path.

steps.task: Add a focused regression test for the GPT Researcher MCP Dockerfiles.
validation: python -m pytest -q tests/docker/test_gptr_mcp_dockerfile.py fails before the Dockerfile fix because /app/server.py compatibility and version 0.15.1 are absent.

steps.task: Patch both GPT Researcher MCP Dockerfile copies minimally.
validation: Both Dockerfiles copy src/ and tools/ before uv pip install .[services] so clean-cache builds include all pyproject-declared package directories.
Both Dockerfiles create /app/server.py as a wrapper that loads /app/gptr-mcp/server.py with /app/gptr-mcp on sys.path.
The wrapper defaults to stdio for bare docker exec MCP clients.
Both Dockerfiles run the long-lived container service with DOPEMUX_GPTR_TRANSPORT=sse.
